newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Brussels bourse seen charting new records.
newsitem.headline: Brussels bourse seen charting new records.

text.p: 0745 GMT - Bel-20 index seen setting new record high during Tuesday's session after steep overnight rally in New York and with dividend payment season nearing.
* Bel-20 ended Monday 1.04 points up at new closing high of 2,254.87 after earlier hitting new life high of 2,263.55.
* Dow Jones Industrial Average .DJI climbed 143.29 points to 7,214.49.
